key.name: overlay-key-action
key.description: Controls the action of the overlay key (Super): launcher, overview, or app-grid

key.name: enable-super-enter
key.description: Bind Super+Enter (Return and KP_Enter) to open or close the Tide launcher

key.name: toggle-launcher
key.description: Keyboard accelerators that open or close the Tide application and open-window launcher

key.name: max-results
key.description: Maximum number of results displayed in the Tide launcher list (3 to 15)

key.name: search-open-windows
key.summary: Include open windows in launcher search
key.description: Search and switch to open windows across workspaces alongside installed applications

key.name: sort-by-usage
key.description: Order installed applications by Shell.AppUsage frequency when true, or alphabetically when false

key.name: show-descriptions
key.summary: Show application descriptions and window workspace subtitles
key.description: Display description or workspace subtitle beneath each launcher result title

key.name: show-shortcut-badges
key.description: Display Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+9 keyboard shortcut badges on the right side of the first nine results

key.name: clear-search-on-open
key.summary: Clear search query when opening launcher
key.description: Reset the search entry text whenever the Tide launcher modal opens

key.name: close-on-outside-click
key.summary: Close launcher when clicking outside dialog
key.description: Dismiss the Tide modal dialog when clicking anywhere outside its bounds

key.name: dialog-width
key.description: Horizontal width of the Tide launcher modal dialog (480 to 960 px)

key.name: result-icon-size
key.description: Application icon texture size inside each launcher result row (24 to 64 px)

key.name: show-dialog-border
key.summary: Show accent border around Tide launcher modal
key.description: Draw a high-contrast accent border ring around the Tide launcher dialog and focused search entry

key.name: border-width
key.summary: Launcher dialog border width in pixels
key.description: Thickness of the Tide launcher accent border ring (0 to 8 px)

key.name: border-radius
key.summary: Launcher dialog corner radius in pixels
key.description: Corner rounding of the Tide launcher modal dialog (0 to 36 px)

key.name: border-color-rgba
key.description: CSS color string for the Tide launcher accent border ring and focused search entry

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Background opacity of the Tide launcher modal surface (60 to 100 percent)
